evals.prompt: We're starting a four-lane effort on this repository: two features may touch input handling, one lane will maintain verification, and one will review. Set up the work so the lanes can begin safely.
evals.expected_output: Assigns lead, feature, guardian, and adversary responsibilities; records the trunk base; checks the shared seam; issues self-contained briefs with scope, exclusions, verification, and reporting requirements; and states that verified squashes serialize through the lead by default.

evals.prompt: My feature lane is ready to land after rebasing onto the latest trunk. Tell me exactly what to verify and what evidence to report.
evals.expected_output: Uses the original authored-from base rather than the rebased parent, uses the current landing tip for --against, runs puck landing and puck citations plus touched batteries, requires independent red-proof for edited batteries, holds the verified squash unpushed, and reports command transcripts and hashes so the lead can rebuild, recheck, and push.

evals.prompt: A reviewer says two independently green input-system landings look fine. One changes focus-loss release behavior and the other derives edit commits from held-button state. Review that conclusion.
evals.expected_output: Challenges the composition rather than accepting isolated green results, applies the recurring-failure discriminators, requests a seam-level mechanical check, and reports findings as CONFIRMED or PLAUSIBLE without implementing fixes.
